The '''Portminia system''' was located in the [[Sprizen sector/Legends|Sprizen sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Transport/Legends|starship]] ''[[Portminian]]''.<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Portminia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-5.<ref name="TEA" />
